newsitem.title: UK: Sears to issue profits warning - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sears to issue profits warning - paper.

text.p: British retailing group Sears Plc is about to publish a fresh profits warning despite the high street mini-boom, the Guardian reported on Thursday.

As rumours of the warning circulated some institutional investors were planning a public campaign to remove Liam Strong, chief executive of the company which includes Selfridges and the British Shoe Corporation, said the newspaper.
It said Sears was preparing to tell investors that profits for the current financial year would be up to 20 percent below current market expectations of around 100 million pounds ($168.9 million).
Shares in the company closed on Wednesday at 91-1/2 pence, a fall of 2-1/2 pence on the day. ($1=.5922 Pound)
